title: New-user activation
question: What should first-run success feel like for Takkle?

options.label: Claim → live dossier
options.thesis: Player aha = claimed profile with film and Tackle Score visible. Business aha = finding athletes via NIL Scores. Tutorials are short step paths that end in real product actions.
options.viewport: Signed-in homepage shows role path + checklist. Tutorials: 4 steps each, skippable, deep-link into claim / NIL.
options.risk: Business side stays thin until NIL product deepens.

options.label: Discovery first
options.thesis: Everyone’s aha is seeing real players and scores immediately. Tutorials are lighter orientation; claim/NIL are secondary CTAs.
options.viewport: New-user homepage leads with featured/trending like marketing home, plus a thin role strip.
options.risk: Players may delay claiming if discovery feels like the product.

options.label: Pick your lane
options.thesis: Anonymous and new users hit a role chooser (Player / Business / Recruiter) that routes into the matching tutorial before the product.
options.viewport: Full-bleed path cards replace the current marketing hero for first visit.
options.risk: Adds a gate before value; experienced users need a strong skip.
